Arts of the Smithsonian Institution, we do want to cover that really magnificent outline prepared by Mr. Taylor, Mr. J.R. Taylor. We understand that our first tape was liked in Washington and myself, Art Smith, was very happy to have the chance to meet both Mr. Taylor and the famous Martin Williams.

Now to go into the interview here at the Afterhours. We were talking about some of the old rooms in Kansas City that Baby played and that Crook played and we came along with one; I thought I'd heard about most of them with my band, traveling with my band, they talked about the rooms and the people so much, but here is one called the Yellow Front, which is around 18th and Forest, where the bands used to play and it was a great place for jam sessions. Could you tell us more about the Yellow Front, Baby? Well, what…
